title: Stout
summary: Tier-1 gear prefix for weapons, armor, shields, and helms that grants a small bonus to Body.

p: Thickened with pig-iron rivets and provincial stubbornness.

Border smiths leave extra iron in the haft and thicker leather in the straps when they know a recruit will abuse his kit. Nothing elegant about it—just honest weight that helps a tired soldier keep his feet.

title: Oxen
summary: Tier-2 gear prefix for weapons, armor, shields, and boots that provides a modest Body increase.

p: Heavy enough to leave ruts in the frontier mud.

Named for the broad-shouldered draft beasts that haul salt wagons through axle-deep Redmarsh mire. Gear stamped with the Oxen mark feels stubbornly solid, lending its wearer the grit to shrug off heavy shoves.

title: Quarry-Born
summary: Tier-3 gear prefix for weapons, armor, and shields that grants a solid bonus to Body.

p: Forged by men who died of stone-lung before thirty.

Tempered in the smoky pit-forges of the Deep Quarry where ironstone dust coats every lung and every anvil. Armor and blades bearing this craft carry the dense, unforgiving heft of freshly split basalt.

title: Colossus-Wrought
summary: Tier-4 gear prefix for weapons, armor, and shields that delivers a high Body bonus.

p: It does not fit a human shoulder; the shoulder must adapt.
Forged over caldera vents using salvaged fragments of awakened siege-golems. Even a lean veteran feels his grip harden and his stance widen the moment he buckles on colossus-wrought steel.

title: Lucid
summary: Tier-1 gear prefix for weapons, helms, armor, rings, and amulets that adds a small bonus to Mind.

p: Keeps the marsh-fever fog at bay for another hour.
Wiped clean with vinegar and etched with a single neat margin-line by hedge-scholars who hated foggy thinking. It clears the headache of a wet march and keeps simple incantations crisp.

title: Scribe-Marked
summary: Tier-2 gear prefix for weapons, helms, armor, and rings that grants a modest boost to Mind.

p: Notched with tiny, obsessive tally marks in the margin.

Tiny probate tallies and copper-ink notes line the inner rim of these pieces. Clerks of the lower parishes swore that keeping good arithmetic close to the skin sharpened a caster's focus under pressure.

title: Vesperal
summary: Tier-3 gear prefix for weapons, helms, armor, and amulets that provides a solid Mind increase.

p: Smells faintly of snuffed church tallow and cold stone.

Enchanted during the quiet hour between dusk and the first watch-bell, when coastal abbey scriptoriums fall completely silent. Wearers find their thoughts cutting cleanly through smoke, noise, and panic.

title: Archon-Forged
summary: Tier-4 gear prefix for weapons, helms, armor, and amulets that grants a high Mind bonus.

p: Hums with a geometry that makes the teeth ache.
Crafted by senior Spire Conclave masters who measured mana-flow down to the last copper filament. Holding an archon-forged piece feels like stepping into a well-lit study in the middle of a riot.

title: Brisk
summary: Tier-1 gear prefix for boots, weapons, and armor that adds a light bonus to movement or action speed.

p: Lightened by paring away every ounce of ornament.
Trimmed of excess buckles and greased with mutton tallow by couriers who got paid by the mile. A brisk kit keeps a scout half a stride ahead of the mud and the dogs.

title: Fleet
summary: Tier-2 gear prefix for boots, weapons, and rings that provides a noticeable speed increase.

p: Made for couriers who are paid only if they survive.
Favored by Twin Passes outriders who learned that standing still in a sandstone canyon is a quick way to catch a hornbow shaft. Every ounce of dead weight is pared away for pure, nimble pace.

title: Galestrung
summary: Tier-3 gear prefix for boots, weapons, and amulets that grants a high speed bonus.

p: The leather whistles sharply when swung against the wind.

Strung with salt-cured sinew and wind-blessed copper wire along Oakhaven's stormy cliffs. Wearers move with the sudden, snapping urgency of a coastal squall, closing gaps before enemy archers can draw.

title: Hale
summary: Tier-1 gear prefix for armor, helms, shields, rings, and amulets that adds a small amount of maximum health.

p: Smells of boiled leather and willow-bark poultice.
Stitched with dried willow-bark charms and honest wool padding to keep winter chill out of the ribs. Frontier levies prize hale gear simply because it helps a man walk away from a bad morning.

title: Blood-Warm
summary: Tier-2 gear prefix for armor, helms, shields, and amulets that provides a moderate maximum health bonus.

p: Retains the heat of its previous owner's final fever.
Quenched in warm iron-rich spring water rather than cold river brine, leaving the metal oddly comforting against the skin. Soldiers on night picket swear it keeps their fingers nimble through sleet.

title: Sinew-Bound
summary: Tier-3 gear prefix for armor, helms, shields, and rings that grants a strong maximum health increase.

p: Stitched with cured salt-marsh tendon that refuses to part.

Reinforced with layered rawhide and boiled ox-sinew by veteran camp-surgeons who grew tired of stitching open bellies. The binding flexes with the ribcage, absorbing impacts that would otherwise snap bone.

title: Undying
summary: Tier-4 gear prefix for armor, shields, and amulets that delivers a massive boost to maximum health.

p: The heart keeps beating long after the mind begs it to stop.

Stamped with a stubborn First-Dynasty vitality seal recovered from deep coastal crypts. Veterans wearing undying kit have a habit of crawling back out of collapsed trenches long after their company wrote them off.

title: Wellspring
summary: Tier-1 gear prefix for weapons, helms, armor, rings, and amulets that adds a small pool of maximum mana.

p: Condensation gathers on the rim even in the dry wastes.

Inlaid with a sliver of river-quartz that drinks stray dew and ambient ley-charge alike. Apprentice mages trade their supper rations for wellspring trinkets just to squeeze one extra bolt out of a skirmish.

title: Deep-Vessel
summary: Tier-2 gear prefix for weapons, helms, armor, and amulets that grants a moderate maximum mana increase.

p: Hollowed out to hold more aether than is strictly safe.
Hollowed and lined with thin silver foil by Redmarsh artificers who understood the value of a deep cistern. It holds arcane charge cleanly through dry desert marches where ambient mana runs thin.

title: Ley-Steeped
summary: Tier-3 gear prefix for weapons, helms, armor, and rings that provides a strong maximum mana bonus.

p: Buried for seven winters beneath a cracked border cairn.
Left buried for a full moon beside a humming plateau wardstone until the metal itself began to tingle. Casters feel a steady, cold pressure humming at their fingertips whenever they grip it.

title: Astral-Font
summary: Tier-4 gear prefix for weapons, helms, armor, and amulets that delivers a huge maximum mana pool.

p: Staring into the polish reveals stars that died centuries ago.
Tempered over deep coastal rifts where ocean currents cross ancient ley-lines. Even a senior arcanist rarely drains an astral-font piece dry before the battlefield falls quiet.

title: Riveted
summary: Tier-1 gear prefix for armor, shields, helms, and boots that adds a small amount of flat armor.

p: Patched with boilerplate from a dismantled river barge.
Ugly, heavy-headed iron rivets hammered cold into worn leather and scrap plate. Thornwick smiths do not promise comfort, only that the seams will hold when a gnoll cleaver bites.

title: Bastion-Grade
summary: Tier-2 gear prefix for armor, shields, helms, and boots that grants a moderate armor increase.

p: Stamped with the quartermaster's seal of Oakhaven.
Built to the thick, squared-off specifications of Oakhaven's seawall garrisons. Bastion-grade kit turns aside crossfire and falling masonry alike, though it makes climbing ladders a noisy chore.

title: Citadel-Plated
summary: Tier-3 gear prefix for armor, shields, and helms that provides a heavy armor bonus.

p: Turns aside crossbow quarrels with a dull, indifferent thud.
Layered with overlapping black steel salvaged from highland fortress armories. Men clad in citadel-plated harness advance like moving gatehouses, shrugging off volleys that shred ordinary mail.

title: True-Sighted
summary: Tier-2 gear prefix for weapons, helms, and rings that improves combat accuracy.

p: Balanced to compensate for a trembling, gin-soaked hand.
Balanced with a surveyor's plumb-bob and polished until the sight-line catches no glare. Marksmen and duelists alike pay extra for true-sighted gear when fighting in thick bog-fog.

title: Unerring
summary: Tier-4 gear prefix for weapons, helms, rings, and amulets that grants a high accuracy bonus.

p: Finds the gap between gorget and collarbone without being asked.

Calibrated by Collegium lens-grinders using smoked quartz and star-silver wire. Whether loosing an arrow across a canyon or driving a spear through a visor slit, an unerring piece rarely wastes a strike.

title: of the Ford
summary: Tier-1 suffix for boots, armor, and shields that grants light cold resistance.

p: Greased with mutton tallow against the icy river shallows.
Greased with goose-fat and lined with rough sheep's wool by Alder River ferrymen. Anyone who has stood waist-deep in November meltwater knows why border troops guard these linings like silver.

title: of Winter Watch
summary: Tier-2 suffix for armor, helms, boots, amulets, and rings that provides moderate cold resistance.

p: Worn by sentries who chipped frost from their eyelids at dawn.
Issued to highland pickets who kept watch over snow-choked passes long after the supply wagons stopped coming. The wool stays dry under sleet and keeps frostbite out of the knuckles.

title: of the Rime-Vault
summary: Tier-4 suffix for armor, shields, amulets, and rings that delivers high cold resistance.

p: Cold no longer bites the flesh; it merely recognizes kin.
Bound with pale alpine frost-wards recovered from ancient mountain cisterns. Even the bitter breath of a frost-bell or glacial titan slides off the rime-vault weave without numbing the skin.

title: of the Slag-Heap
summary: Tier-1 suffix for armor, shields, boots, and helms that adds light fire resistance.

p: Blackened in the coal pits outside Thornwick.
Dusted with crushed furnace clinker and rubbed with wet clay by smelter apprentices. It leaves black smudges on everything you touch, yet keeps stray embers from chewing through your cloak.

title: of the Kiln
summary: Tier-2 suffix for armor, shields, helms, rings, and amulets that grants moderate fire resistance.

p: Baked until the metal forgot how to melt. Forged onto armor, shield, helm, ring, amulet (tier 2) to confer Fire res 16-26.
Cured beside the vitrified brick ovens of Greywood until the leather toughened like old horn. Sappers wear kiln-treated gear when clearing burning barricades and cinderling nests.

title: of the Caldera
summary: Tier-4 suffix for armor, shields, amulets, and rings that delivers high fire resistance.

p: Quenched in the ash-choked vents beneath Ironcamp.
Forged with asbestos weave and quenched in volcanic ash inside Ironcamp's deepest yards. Wearers can wade through blistering heat and magma spray that would cook ordinary plate.

title: of the Fen
summary: Tier-1 suffix for boots, armor, helms, and rings that grants light poison resistance.

p: Stained yellow by decades of wading through stagnant peat.
Steeped in bitter bog-myrtle and peat-smoke by Fenwick ditch-cutters. It smells like an old wet cellar, which happens to be the best way to keep marsh-venom and biting flies at bay.

title: of the Salt-Pan
summary: Tier-2 suffix for armor, helms, boots, amulets, and rings that provides moderate poison resistance.

p: Crusted with bitter desert alkali that neutralizes venom.
Treated with slaked lime and boiled vinegar by Redmarsh caravan guards. Alkali-cured gear shrugs off viper spit and toxic marsh brine that would rot untreated leather in a single afternoon.

title: of the Bile-Ward
summary: Tier-4 suffix for armor, shields, amulets, and rings that delivers high poison resistance.

p: Steeped in mithridate until the wearer's spit turns bitter.
Anointed with coastal abbey preservatives designed for men who spend their lives sealing plague-crypts. Even the vilest spore-matron cloud turns thin and harmless against a bile-ward seal.

title: of Grounding
summary: Tier-1 suffix for boots, armor, helms, and shields that adds light lightning resistance.

p: Threaded with cheap copper wire that trails into the dirt.
A braided strand of cheap copper tacked from collar to heel so stray static runs straight into the mud. Ugly work, yet it has saved more than one scout from a dune-scarab's bite.

title: of Fulgurite
summary: Tier-2 suffix for armor, shields, helms, rings, and amulets that grants moderate lightning resistance.

p: Set with hollow glass tubes fused where lightning struck the dunes.
Inlaid with glassy tubes of sand fused by desert lightning strikes across the Quartz Plateau. The vitrified mineral drinks electrical surges with a dry crackle and leaves the wearer unscathed.

title: of the Storm-Rod
summary: Tier-4 suffix for armor, shields, amulets, and rings that delivers high lightning resistance.

p: Drinks the tempest and leaves only the smell of ozone.

Modeled after the heavy bronze lightning arrestors bolted atop Harborwatch's lighthouse. Storm-rod gear lets frontline soldiers stand right under a stormtree's boughs without smelling like burnt hair.

title: of Spite
summary: Tier-1 suffix for weapons, rings, and amulets that adds a small critical strike bonus.

p: Nicknamed by a cutthroat who never fought fair in his life.
Filed with a deliberate, nasty burr along the edge by border brawlers who never fought fair. It catches on leather straps and turns ordinary grazing cuts into ugly, bleeding gouges.

title: of the Abattoir
summary: Tier-2 suffix for weapons, rings, and amulets that grants a moderate critical strike bonus.

p: Designed for dismemberment rather than honorable dueling.
Weighted like a Thornwick slaughterhouse cleaver so the blade drops straight through joint and gristle without bouncing. Quartermasters frown at the name, yet every mercenary asks for one.

title: of Severed Sinew
summary: Tier-3 suffix for weapons, rings, and amulets that provides a strong critical strike bonus.

p: Every edge is honed to seek the softest part of a man.
Honed by field surgeons turned mercenaries who knew every soft seam beneath a soldier's mail. A single clean thrust finds the gap where armor ends and panic begins.

title: of the Headsman
summary: Tier-4 suffix for weapons, rings, and amulets that delivers a high critical strike bonus.

p: Requires only one clean stroke to settle an argument.
Balanced for one final, unanswerable stroke rather than polite fencing. Headsman-marked steel carries a grim reputation along the Border, as few enemies ever survive its first clean landing.

title: of the Wood-Tick
summary: Tier-1 suffix for weapons and rings that grants light lifesteal on hit.

p: Drinks modestly from the cut, leaving the wound oddly pale.
Scratched with a crude fen-leech charm by desperate poachers who could not afford healing draughts. It draws only a thin trickle of vigor per strike, yet every drop counts in a ditch fight.

title: of the Redmarsh Leech
summary: Tier-2 suffix for weapons, rings, and amulets that provides moderate lifesteal on hit.

p: The hilt grows warm and slick the longer the melee drags on.
Tempered in brackish Redmarsh pools teeming with fat alkali leeches. The metal feels strangely clammy in the palm, drinking enemy vitality with every cut to keep its wielder upright.

title: of the Tithe
summary: Tier-3 suffix for weapons, rings, and amulets that grants strong lifesteal on hit.

p: Collects what is owed in crimson coin. Forged onto weapon, ring, amulet (tier 3) to confer Life steal 7-10.
Stamped with the Salt-Tithe Commission's sharpest foreclosure mark, repurposed by mercenaries with a dark sense of humor. Every blow collects its due straight from the target's veins.

title: of the Crimson Thirst
summary: Tier-4 suffix for weapons and amulets that delivers high lifesteal on hit.

p: It does not merely drink; it demands a second course.
Whispered to be forged by rogue abbey clerks who crossed the line from auditing the dead to feeding on the living. A blade of the crimson thirst turns reckless charges into eerie endurance.

title: of Quietude
summary: Tier-1 suffix for helms, armor, rings, and amulets that adds light mana regeneration.

p: Steadies the breathing when the shields begin to splinter.
Worn by country wayshrine keepers who needed peace of mind amid barking hounds and leaking roofs. It steadies the breath and lets a caster's mana trickle back between skirmishes.

title: of the Cistern
summary: Tier-2 suffix for weapons, helms, armor, rings, and amulets that grants moderate mana regeneration.

p: Slowly refills itself from the damp air of the world.
Etched with the interlocking water-channels of Ironheart's old engineering blueprints. Even when the surrounding air is parched and dead, a cistern-marked piece keeps a steady stream of mana flowing.

title: of the Pendulum
summary: Tier-3 suffix for weapons, helms, rings, and amulets that provides strong mana regeneration.

p: Ticks with a rhythmic, unseen momentum. Forged onto weapon, helm, ring, amulet (tier 3) to confer Mana regen 5-7.
Calibrated to the steady tick of Oakhaven's brass tide-clocks. Casters who wear it fall into a calm, relentless rhythm, recovering mana almost as fast as they can spend it.

title: of the Unbroken Circle
summary: Tier-4 suffix for weapons, helms, armor, and amulets that delivers high mana regeneration.

p: What is spent in fire returns in smoke. Forged onto weapon, helm, armor, amulet (tier 4) to confer Mana regen 8-12.
Inscribed with the Collegium's closed-loop furnace glyph, recycling stray heat and spent charge back into fresh power. Senior archons treasure it during long caldera sieges where rest is impossible.

title: Riveted
summary: Tier-1 prefix for armor and shields that adds flat physical armor.

p: "Riveted" (Prefix, tier 1) — Peened and double-riveted on Ironcamp anvils to turn aside lance tips, shrapnel, and crushing warhammers. Bound to armor, shield, conferring +4 Armor.
Double-punched iron studs hammered straight through boiled hide in Thornwick's muddy smithy yards. It rattles when you run, yet it stops a gnoll hatchet from splitting your ribs.

title: Bog-Stained
summary: Tier-1 prefix for armor and boots that grants poison resistance.

p: "Bog-Stained" (Prefix, tier 1) — Cured in acidic fen-tannin and mineral pitch to turn away rot while coating edges in lingering venom. Bound to armor, boots, conferring +12 Poison res.
Soaked in dark Fenwick peat-water until the leather turns permanently brown and smells of wet moss. Marsh-guides swear the tannin seals the pores against venom and ditch-rot alike.

title: Notched
summary: Tier-1 weapon prefix that adds a modest flat damage bonus.

p: "Notched" (Prefix, tier 1) — Ground on wet quarry whetstones until the bevel bites straight through iron rings and boiled leather. Bound to weapon, conferring +3 Damage.
Border veterans file shallow serrations into cheap blades so they bite into wool and leather instead of glancing off. Quartermasters hate sharpening them, yet nobody argues with the results.

title: Waxed
summary: Tier-1 prefix for bows and gloves that improves accuracy.

p: "Waxed" (Prefix, tier 1) — Balanced and shaved to feather-light tolerances so scouts and archers loose without hesitation. Bound to bow, gloves, conferring +6 Accuracy.
Rubbed down with warm beeswax and pine pitch to keep rain from swelling the wood or slicking the grip. A dry, tacky hold keeps an archer's draw dead steady in a downpour.

title: Tallow-Sealed
summary: Tier-1 prefix for armor and boots that provides cold resistance.

p: "Tallow-Sealed" (Prefix, tier 1) — Quenched in winter river-rime and coastal brine to bleed warmth from incoming blows and chill exposed steel. Bound to armor, boots, conferring +12 Cold res.
Smeared thick with mutton tallow along every stitch-hole before marching into the northern drizzle. It attracts hungry camp dogs, yet it keeps freezing river-water from soaking through to the skin.

title: Pauper-Inked
summary: Entry-level caster prefix for wands, staves, and robes that expands maximum mana for early skirmishes.

p: "Pauper-Inked" (Prefix, tier 1) — Etched with fine silver survey-sigils that draw stray ley-current straight out of the air. Bound to wand, staff, robe, conferring +14 Max Mana.

Hedge-scribes who could not afford gilt silver mixed oak-gall with lampblack to trace mana-glyphs along cheap cloth and wood. The lines smudge in the rain and stain the wearer's cuffs grey, yet they still hold enough charge for an extra bolt.

title: Quarry-Hewn
summary: Second-tier weapon prefix that adds armor penetration to crack heavy hides and riveted frontier plate.

p: "Quarry-Hewn" (Prefix, tier 2) — Peened and double-riveted on Ironcamp anvils to turn aside lance tips, shrapnel, and crushing warhammers. Bound to weapon, conferring +5 Armor pen.

Shaped with blunt stone-splitting chisels in the Deep Quarry work-yards rather than polished on a guild wheel. The edge looks ugly and raw, yet it wedges neatly into iron seams where finer swords only glance off.

title: Alkali-Cured
summary: Defensive tier-2 armor prefix granting both fire and poison resistance for harsh Redmarsh marches.

p: "Alkali-Cured" (Prefix, tier 2) — Tempered over caldera slag-coals and rubbed with brimstone oil so heat clings along every seam. Bound to armor, conferring +16 Fire res, +10 Poison res.

Caravan tanners soak thick oxhide in warm salt-pan brine and wood-ash until the leather turns pale and stiff as board. It smells sour in wet weather, though it shrugs off viper spit and brush-fires with quiet stubbornness.

title: Salt-Bitten
summary: Offensive tier-2 weapon prefix boosting raw damage and critical strike chance on close-quarters gear.

p: "Salt-Bitten" (Prefix, tier 2) — Ground on wet quarry whetstones until the bevel bites straight through iron rings and boiled leather. Bound to weapon, conferring +6 Damage, +4 Crit %.

Left overnight in brackish coastal tide-pools before grinding, salt-bitten steel develops microscopic pits along the bevel. Field surgeons hate stitching up the ragged wounds it leaves, which is precisely why raiders prize it.

title: Copper-Wound
summary: Caster prefix at tier 2 for staves, wands, and hats, providing lightning resistance and steady mana regeneration.

p: "Copper-Wound" (Prefix, tier 2) — Wound with hair-fine copper grounding filaments copied from Thermodynamic Conclave coils. Bound to staff, wand, hat, conferring +18 Lightning res, +0.8 Mana regen.

Thin coils of salvaged telegraph and smelter wire bound tightly around the haft or brim bleed stray sparks straight into the dirt. Storm-coast arcanists swear the faint hum keeps their minds awake during long wet watches.

title: Fen-Stalking
summary: Agile tier-2 prefix for boots and armor that raises both evasion and movement speed across rough ground.

p: "Fen-Stalking" (Prefix, tier 2) — Balanced and shaved to feather-light tolerances so scouts and archers loose without hesitation. Bound to boots, armor, conferring +7 Evasion %, +6 Move speed %.

Greased with otter-fat and stripped of jingling brass buckles by poachers who worked the Greywood ditches. Wearing it feels like trading heavy parade kit for a second skin that slips cleanly past clutching roots and clumsy spears.

title: Notarized
summary: Hex-focused tier-2 prefix for wands, rings, and amulets that amplifies damage-over-time effects.

p: "Notarized" (Prefix, tier 2) — Cured in acidic fen-tannin and mineral pitch to turn away rot while coating edges in lingering venom. Bound to wand, ring, amulet, conferring +12 Dot dmg %.

Stamped with a tiny lead probate seal by clerks who treated battlefield curses like overdue tax assessments. Once a target is marked by a notarized focus, the affliction settles in like a lien that refuses to be discharged early.

title: Annealed
summary: Sturdy tier-3 prefix for armor and shields that grants both flat physical armor and extra maximum health.

p: "Annealed" (Prefix, tier 3) — Peened and double-riveted on Ironcamp anvils to turn aside lance tips, shrapnel, and crushing warhammers. Bound to armor, shield, conferring +12 Armor, +30 Max hp.

Heated slow in charcoal banks and cooled overnight in dry ash so the metal loses its brittle temper. Annealed plates bend slightly under a heavy maul instead of shattering into the wearer's ribs, earning every copper of smithy pay.

title: Bodkin-Tipped
summary: Armor-piercing tier-3 bow prefix adding flat damage and penetration against heavily plated targets.

p: "Bodkin-Tipped" (Prefix, tier 3) — Peened and double-riveted on Ironcamp anvils to turn aside lance tips, shrapnel, and crushing warhammers. Bound to bow, conferring +10 Damage, +7 Armor pen.

Oakhaven fletchers draw four-sided iron points specifically for punching through linked mail at fifty paces. A bow fitted and tuned for bodkin shafts wastes no energy on wide cuts, driving straight into the meat behind the steel.

title: Galvanic
summary: Crackling tier-3 prefix for staves and wands that adds lightning damage and faster casting speed.

p: "Galvanic" (Prefix, tier 3) — Wound with hair-fine copper grounding filaments copied from Thermodynamic Conclave coils. Bound to staff, wand, conferring +12 Lightning dmg, +8 Cast speed %.

Calibrated with slivers of plateau quartz that snap audibly whenever the bearer lifts a hand. The static jolt hurries the caster's gestures along, though careless apprentices often end up with singed knuckles and standing hair.

title: Bitumen-Coated
summary: Protective tier-3 armor prefix delivering high poison resistance alongside a solid boost to maximum health.

p: "Bitumen-Coated" (Prefix, tier 3) — Cured in acidic fen-tannin and mineral pitch to turn away rot while coating edges in lingering venom. Bound to armor, conferring +22 Poison res, +35 Max hp.

Brushed warm with black mineral pitch dredged from sunken Third-Dynasty quays. The tarry sheen ruins any tunic worn underneath, yet it seals out marsh spores, bog-venom, and freezing ditch water for weeks on end.

title: Windlass-Spanned
summary: Heavy tier-3 bow prefix that boosts base damage and critical strike damage for deliberate marksmen.

p: "Windlass-Spanned" (Prefix, tier 3) — Balanced and shaved to feather-light tolerances so scouts and archers loose without hesitation. Bound to bow, conferring +12 Damage, +18 Crit dmg %.

Reinforced with iron stirrups and gear-notches borrowed from harborwall siege prods. Drawing it takes iron shoulders and patience, yet a single clean release hits with enough force to knock a shielded raider off his heels.

title: Indentured
summary: Summoner-oriented tier-3 prefix for wands, robes, and amulets that boosts minion health and maximum mana.

p: "Indentured" (Prefix, tier 3) — Notarized in Lower-Parish probate ink, binding summoned skeletons and mercs tighter to the bearer’s will. Bound to wand, robe, amulet, conferring +18 Minion hp %, +28 Max Mana.

Woven with narrow slips of stamped contract parchment tucked straight into the lining. Raised servants bound through an indentured focus stay upright far longer, refusing to collapse until their clerk signs off on the shift.

title: Meteor-Forged
summary: High-impact tier-4 weapon prefix granting heavy damage and strong armor penetration against elite foes.

p: "Meteor-Forged" (Prefix, tier 4) — Peened and double-riveted on Ironcamp anvils to turn aside lance tips, shrapnel, and crushing warhammers. Bound to weapon, conferring +18 Damage, +10 Armor pen.

Hammered from dark sky-iron pried out of highland craters where ordinary coal fires barely soften the ore. Smiths ruin two hammers shaping a single blade, yet the finished edge shears through basalt plates like soft pine.

title: Slag-Quenched
summary: Heat-hardened tier-4 prefix for armor and shields adding substantial armor and strong fire resistance.

p: "Slag-Quenched" (Prefix, tier 4) — Tempered over caldera slag-coals and rubbed with brimstone oil so heat clings along every seam. Bound to armor, shield, conferring +20 Armor, +24 Fire res.

Plunged red-hot into molten volcanic dross inside Ironcamp's deepest sheds until a dull glassy crust seals the steel. Soldiers wearing slag-quenched harness walk through burning pitch trenches smelling of sulfur and unbothered by flame.

title: Pre-Schism
summary: Scholarly tier-4 prefix for staves, wands, and hats that boosts intellect and high mana regeneration.

p: "Pre-Schism" (Prefix, tier 4) — Etched with fine silver survey-sigils that draw stray ley-current straight out of the air. Bound to staff, wand, hat, conferring +6 Int, +1.6 Mana regen.

Salvaged from libraries sealed before the Caldera fissures ever cracked the southern horizon. The fine silver inlay hums with a clean, orderly cadence that modern Collegium workshops have tried and failed to copy for a century.

title: Oath-Bound
summary: Commanding tier-4 prefix for robes, amulets, and rings that increases minion damage and all resistances.

p: "Oath-Bound" (Prefix, tier 4) — Notarized in Lower-Parish probate ink, binding summoned skeletons and mercs tighter to the bearer’s will. Bound to robe, amulet, ring, conferring +22 Minion dmg %, +12 All res.

Inscribed with the double-witness vows of the coastal abbeys, binding servant and master under a single iron rubric. Skeletons and spirits tethered to oath-bound gear strike with grim precision while elemental blasts slide off the bearer.

title: Smoke-Veiled
summary: Elusive tier-4 prefix for armor, boots, and hats combining high evasion with sharper critical strike chance.

p: "Smoke-Veiled" (Prefix, tier 4) — Balanced and shaved to feather-light tolerances so scouts and archers loose without hesitation. Bound to armor, boots, hat, conferring +12 Evasion %, +8 Crit %.

Cured over smoldering peat-fires and rubbed with caldera soot until the fabric drinks torchlight instead of reflecting it. Scouts slip through crossfire like drifting chimney haze, landing cruel strikes before anyone spots their silhouette.

title: Brine-Tempered
summary: Coastal tier-4 prefix for shields and armor granting high cold resistance and improved block chance.

p: "Brine-Tempered" (Prefix, tier 4) — Quenched in winter river-rime and coastal brine to bleed warmth from incoming blows and chill exposed steel. Bound to shield, armor, conferring +26 Cold res, +10 Block %.

Quenched in freezing Western Sea surf while still cherry-red on the tongs, giving the iron a mottled, salt-hardened grain. Harborwatch marines trust brine-tempered shields to turn away both sleet-gales and heavy boarding axes.

title: Sovereign
summary: Pinnacle tier-5 weapon prefix delivering massive damage, critical strike chance, and raw strength.

p: "Sovereign" (Prefix, tier 5) — Ground on wet quarry whetstones until the bevel bites straight through iron rings and boiled leather. Bound to weapon, conferring +28 Damage, +10 Crit %, +7 Str.

Stamped with the high-assay crest once reserved for marshals who commanded entire frontier legions. Holding a sovereign blade carries an unmistakable authority, turning every measured swing into a verdict that breaks shields and morale alike.

title: Anchor-Sealed
summary: Endgame tier-5 prefix for armor and shields providing massive physical armor and broad all-resistances.

p: "Anchor-Sealed" (Prefix, tier 5) — Peened and double-riveted on Ironcamp anvils to turn aside lance tips, shrapnel, and crushing warhammers. Bound to armor, shield, conferring +32 Armor, +18 All res.

Bound with microscopic wards copied directly from the Threshold's great stability pylons. Men clad in anchor-sealed plate stand unmoved amid volcanic shockwaves and elemental barrages that flatten ordinary fortifications.

title: Caldera-Born
summary: Volcanic tier-5 prefix for staves, wands, and robes boosting fire spell damage and strong fire resistance.

p: "Caldera-Born" (Prefix, tier 5) — Tempered over caldera slag-coals and rubbed with brimstone oil so heat clings along every seam. Bound to staff, wand, robe, conferring +25 Fire dmg %, +30 Fire res.

Tempered over open magma vents where the air shimmers thick enough to blister bare cheeks. Arcanists who carry caldera-born gear drink the furnace heat straight into their spells while remaining cool as slate inside their sleeves.

title: First-Watch
summary: Resolute tier-5 prefix for armor, hats, and amulets granting huge maximum health and strong morale resistance.

p: "First-Watch" (Prefix, tier 5) — Stamped with First Watch endurance wards prized by vanguard pikemen holding narrow river crossings. Bound to armor, hat, amulet, conferring +95 Max hp, +25 Morale res.

Modeled on the stern, unadorned kit of the ancient sentinels who held the inner passes before the Crown existed. Wearers simply refuse to panic or fold, standing their post long after lesser companies would have broken.

title: Foreclosing
summary: Ruthless tier-5 weapon prefix combining heavy damage with potent lifesteal on every landed blow.

p: "Foreclosing" (Prefix, tier 5) — Inlaid with stamped assay marks and copper tally-rings favored by Redmarsh caravaneers and bailiffs. Bound to weapon, conferring +6 Lifesteal %, +24 Damage.

Quartermasters whisper that these blades were struck for the Synod's most feared debt-collectors. Every cut collects vitality straight from the enemy's veins, keeping the wielder relentlessly upright until the last account is settled.

title: Star-Iron
summary: Rare tier-5 prefix for weapons and armor pairing high all-resistances with devastating critical damage.

p: "Star-Iron" (Prefix, tier 5) — Ground on wet quarry whetstones until the bevel bites straight through iron rings and boiled leather. Bound to weapon, armor, conferring +20 All res, +30 Crit dmg %.

Smelted from pale meteoric ingots that ring like abbey bells when tapped with a fingernail. Star-iron refuses to rust in bog-water or soften in caldera heat, rewarding clean strikes with bone-splitting precision.

title: of the Ford
summary: Early tier-1 suffix for boots and rings adding light cold resistance and a modest health boost.

p: "of the Ford" (Suffix, tier 1) — Quenched in winter river-rime and coastal brine to bleed warmth from incoming blows and chill exposed steel. Bound to boots, ring, conferring +10 Cold res, +12 Max HP.

Stitched and greased by Alder River ferrymen who spend eight months of the year knee-deep in freezing runoff. Nothing fancy sits on the rim, just honest protection that keeps northern levies marching through November sleet.

title: of Tallies
summary: Practical tier-1 suffix for rings and amulets that increases gold recovered from fallen foes.

p: "of Tallies" (Suffix, tier 1) — Inlaid with stamped assay marks and copper tally-rings favored by Redmarsh caravaneers and bailiffs. Bound to ring, amulet, conferring +10 Gold %.

Notched along the inner band like a Thornwick tax-stick so every copper coin gets counted twice. Mercenaries mock the clerks who wear them right up until payday, when the tallied purse always clinks heavier than theirs.

title: of Dry Socks
summary: Humble tier-1 boot suffix that reduces fatigue buildup during long marches across wet terrain.

p: "of Dry Socks" (Suffix, tier 1) — Inlaid with stamped assay marks and copper tally-rings favored by Redmarsh caravaneers and bailiffs. Bound to boots, conferring +10 Fatigue red.

Every veteran on the Alder front knows you can fight hungry and you can fight bruised, but trench-rot ends a campaign faster than gnolls. Boots bearing this homely blessing keep a soldier's pace steady through ankle-deep mire.

title: of the Ditch
summary: Gritty tier-1 suffix for armor and shields providing extra armor and a small boost to maximum health.

p: "of the Ditch" (Suffix, tier 1) — Peened and double-riveted on Ironcamp anvils to turn aside lance tips, shrapnel, and crushing warhammers. Bound to armor, shield, conferring +3 Armor, +14 Max HP.

Named for the muddy earthworks where Thornwick militia learned to duck arrows and trade blows from the knee. Gear of the ditch looks battered before it leaves the forge, yet it keeps green troops alive through their first ambush.

title: of Goose-Fletch
summary: Steady tier-1 suffix for bows and gloves that sharpens accuracy in wind and drizzle.

p: "of Goose-Fletch" (Suffix, tier 1) — Balanced and shaved to feather-light tolerances so scouts and archers loose without hesitation. Bound to bow, gloves, conferring +7 Accuracy.

Grey river-geese grow stiff, oil-rich wing feathers that refuse to droop when fog rolls off the reeds. Archers trade spare rations for fletching charms, knowing a clean release beats a heavy draw every time.

title: of Gall-Ink
summary: Apprentice tier-1 suffix for wands and rings that grants a useful boost to maximum mana.

p: "of Gall-Ink" (Suffix, tier 1) — Etched with fine silver survey-sigils that draw stray ley-current straight out of the air. Bound to wand, ring, conferring +15 Max Mana.

Prepared from crushed oak-galls and copperas in damp parish back-rooms where paper costs more than bread. The dark stain never washes off the fingers, yet it anchors enough spare mana for an extra ward or bolt.

title: of the Cistern
summary: Desert tier-2 suffix for amulets and rings granting fire resistance and a healthy maximum HP bonus.

p: "of the Cistern" (Suffix, tier 2) — Tempered over caldera slag-coals and rubbed with brimstone oil so heat clings along every seam. Bound to amulet, ring, conferring +16 Fire res, +24 Max HP.

Stamped with the cooling-arch emblem of Ironheart's legendary mountain reservoirs. Redmarsh travelers clutch these trinkets under the white noon glare, swearing the metal stays cool against their chest even when the waterskins run dry.

title: of Sinew
summary: Nimble tier-2 suffix for gloves and bows boosting dexterity and faster attack speed.

p: "of Sinew" (Suffix, tier 2) — Balanced and shaved to feather-light tolerances so scouts and archers loose without hesitation. Bound to gloves, bow, conferring +4 Dex, +7 Atk speed %.

Backed with dried horn and braided ox-tendon cured in warm alkali wind until it snaps like a whip. Marksmen and duelists prize the crisp rebound, loosing two clean shots before an armored foe can close the gap.

title: of Arrears
summary: Grim tier-2 suffix for wands and rings that increases damage-over-time and expands maximum mana.

p: "of Arrears" (Suffix, tier 2) — Cured in acidic fen-tannin and mineral pitch to turn away rot while coating edges in lingering venom. Bound to wand, ring, conferring +14 Dot dmg %, +20 Max Mana.

Born in the probate offices of the lower parishes, where late payments carried penalties harsher than the gallows. Curses cast through gear of arrears bite harder with every passing heartbeat, draining foes who try to stall.

title: of the Pick
summary: Breaching tier-2 weapon suffix adding armor penetration and raw strength for cracking tough hides.

p: "of the Pick" (Suffix, tier 2) — Peened and double-riveted on Ironcamp anvils to turn aside lance tips, shrapnel, and crushing warhammers. Bound to weapon, conferring +6 Armor pen, +3 Str.

Weighted like a Deep Quarry miner's ironstone hammer so the point concentrates all the shoulder's force onto a single spot. Basalt shells and riveted breastplates alike split cleanly when struck with quarry discipline.

title: of Vinegar
summary: Apothecary tier-2 suffix for armor and amulets granting poison resistance and stronger healing received.

p: "of Vinegar" (Suffix, tier 2) — Cured in acidic fen-tannin and mineral pitch to turn away rot while coating edges in lingering venom. Bound to armor, amulet, conferring +18 Poison res, +12 Heal recv %.

Field medics in Redmarsh boil everything from bandages to drinking water with sharp sour vinegar to kill marsh-rot. Gear cured in the same astringent bath turns back venom and helps poultices take hold faster.

title: of the Parapet
summary: Fortified tier-2 suffix for shields and hats that boosts missile resistance and block chance.

p: "of the Parapet" (Suffix, tier 2) — Peened and double-riveted on Ironcamp anvils to turn aside lance tips, shrapnel, and crushing warhammers. Bound to shield, hat, conferring +14 Missile res, +6 Block %.

Designed for wall-sentries who spend entire shifts peering over notched stonework while canyon snipers try to take their ears off. A tilted brim and a high rim turn a storm of hornbow shafts into harmless clatter.

title: of the Sluice
summary: Waterproof tier-3 suffix for armor and boots delivering high cold resistance and extra armor.

p: "of the Sluice" (Suffix, tier 3) — Quenched in winter river-rime and coastal brine to bleed warmth from incoming blows and chill exposed steel. Bound to armor, boots, conferring +22 Cold res, +10 Armor.

Worn by canal lock-keepers who winch heavy iron gates in chest-deep meltwater without losing their grip. Thick oilcloth and cold-hammered iron plates turn freezing spray and stray shrapnel aside with equal indifference.

title: of the Windlass
summary: Precision tier-3 suffix for bows and gloves boosting critical strike damage and dexterity.

p: "of the Windlass" (Suffix, tier 3) — Balanced and shaved to feather-light tolerances so scouts and archers loose without hesitation. Bound to bow, gloves, conferring +22 Crit dmg %, +5 Dex.

Calibrated with tiny brass ratchets copied from Oakhaven's heavy harborwall crossbows. Every draw locks cleanly to the exact same anchor point, letting steady marksmen punch straight through weak seams in enemy plate.

title: of Probate
summary: Administrative tier-3 suffix for wands, staves, and amulets raising minion health and intellect.

p: "of Probate" (Suffix, tier 3) — Notarized in Lower-Parish probate ink, binding summoned skeletons and mercs tighter to the bearer’s will. Bound to wand, staff, amulet, conferring +20 Minion hp %, +5 Int.

Certified under the Third Dynasty's strictest mortuary statutes, where not even a rib bone goes unaccounted for. Necromancers using probate foci field sturdier skeletal ranks that hold formation like seasoned regulars.

title: of Conduction
summary: Storm-ready tier-3 suffix for rings and hats offering high lightning resistance and mana regeneration.

p: "of Conduction" (Suffix, tier 3) — Wound with hair-fine copper grounding filaments copied from Thermodynamic Conclave coils. Bound to ring, hat, conferring +22 Lightning res, +1.3 Mana regen.

Wound with bright annealed copper wire that channels stray static out of the scalp and back into the caster's reserve. Storm-coast mages wear it proudly during gale-force watches when ordinary brass clasps throw sparks.

title: of the Keel
summary: Resilient tier-3 suffix for armor and shields granting substantial maximum health and vitality.

p: "of the Keel" (Suffix, tier 3) — Stamped with First Watch endurance wards prized by vanguard pikemen holding narrow river crossings. Bound to armor, shield, conferring +48 Max hp, +5 Vit.

Built by Oakhaven shipwrights who judged every breastplate the way they judged an ironwood hull-beam: will it hold when the sea slams it? Soldiers wearing keel-marked kit take punishing charges without cracking.

title: of Sightlines
summary: Scouting tier-3 suffix for hats and bows that expands vision range and sharply improves accuracy.

p: "of Sightlines" (Suffix, tier 3) — Balanced and shaved to feather-light tolerances so scouts and archers loose without hesitation. Bound to hat, bow, conferring +2 Vision tiles, +14 Accuracy.

Fitted with smoked-glass brow shades and range-notches favored by coastal falconers and lookout corporals. Spotting an ambush two paces sooner in thick fog or blowing ash is often the whole difference between victory and a shallow grave.

title: of the Fissure
summary: Scorching tier-4 suffix for weapons and armor combining high fire resistance with strong bonus damage.

p: "of the Fissure" (Suffix, tier 4) — Tempered over caldera slag-coals and rubbed with brimstone oil so heat clings along every seam. Bound to weapon, armor, conferring +26 Fire res, +16 Damage.

Quenched in the sulfurous steam rising from caldera cracks where iron glows dull red before it even touches the forge. Gear of the fissure bites hot into enemy flesh while keeping the bearer safe from volcanic vents.

title: of the Witness
summary: Serene tier-4 suffix for amulets and robes granting high mind resistance and stronger healing power.

p: "of the Witness" (Suffix, tier 4) — Etched with fine silver survey-sigils that draw stray ley-current straight out of the air. Bound to amulet, robe, conferring +24 Mind res, +18 Heal power %.

Carried by abbey oath-keepers who stood calm amid panicked retreats and screaming field infirmaries. A clear mind keeps the surgeon's hand steady and stretches every drop of restorative magic across the wounded line.

title: of the Bailiff
summary: Extracting tier-4 suffix for weapons and rings pairing lifesteal with a solid strength bonus.

p: "of the Bailiff" (Suffix, tier 4) — Inlaid with stamped assay marks and copper tally-rings favored by Redmarsh caravaneers and bailiffs. Bound to weapon, ring, conferring +5 Lifesteal %, +6 Str.

The Crown's senior bailiffs never left a parish empty-handed, and mercenaries who copied their iron sigils follow the same rule. Each heavy strike wrings fresh stamina out of the foe to sustain the assault.

title: of the Gauntlet
summary: Siege-grade tier-4 suffix for armor and boots delivering high physical armor and heavy maximum health.

p: "of the Gauntlet" (Suffix, tier 4) — Peened and double-riveted on Ironcamp anvils to turn aside lance tips, shrapnel, and crushing warhammers. Bound to armor, boots, conferring +22 Armor, +65 Max hp.

Tested in the brutal kill-zone canyons outside the Obsidian Caldera where crossfire turns ordinary plate into colanders. Only the thickest layered steel survives the march, earning this grim title from the sappers who made it through.

title: of the Leyline
summary: Channeling tier-4 suffix for staves, wands, and rings adding large maximum mana and faster cast speed.

p: "of the Leyline" (Suffix, tier 4) — Etched with fine silver survey-sigils that draw stray ley-current straight out of the air. Bound to staff, wand, ring, conferring +55 Max Mana, +12 Cast speed %.

Tuned directly to the deep arcane currents pulsing beneath Thornvael's fractured bedrock. Casters attuned to the leyline weave complex barrages effortlessly, their fingers tracing bright sigils faster than archers can nock.

title: of the Cairn
summary: Enduring tier-4 suffix for shields and amulets providing broad all-resistances and extra vitality.

p: "of the Cairn" (Suffix, tier 4) — Wound with hair-fine copper grounding filaments copied from Thermodynamic Conclave coils. Bound to shield, amulet, conferring +14 All res, +6 Vit.

Carved from the grey highland boundary stones that have weathered centuries of frost, fire, and border wars without toppling. Gear of the cairn lends that same stubborn permanence to anyone holding a lonely ridge.

title: of the Threshold
summary: Apex tier-5 suffix for armor and amulets granting high all-resistances and massive maximum health.

p: "of the Threshold" (Suffix, tier 5) — Stamped with First Watch endurance wards prized by vanguard pikemen holding narrow river crossings. Bound to armor, amulet, conferring +18 All res, +100 Max hp.

Inscribed with the solemn lintel-glyphs guarding the deepest chambers beneath the volcanic peaks. Few mortals ever earn a threshold seal, and those who wear it endure elemental fury that would vaporize ordinary troops.

title: of Liquidation
summary: Lethal tier-5 weapon suffix delivering high critical strike chance and devastating critical damage.

p: "of Liquidation" (Suffix, tier 5) — Inlaid with stamped assay marks and copper tally-rings favored by Redmarsh caravaneers and bailiffs. Bound to weapon, conferring +12 Crit %, +32 Crit dmg %.

The final, merciless entry in any quartermaster's book when an account is closed for good. Weapons marked for liquidation find every soft joint and cracked scale, ending protracted duels in a single catastrophic stroke.

title: of the Dais
summary: Commanding tier-5 suffix for armor and rings combining strength, vitality, and heavy physical armor.

p: "of the Dais" (Suffix, tier 5) — Peened and double-riveted on Ironcamp anvils to turn aside lance tips, shrapnel, and crushing warhammers. Bound to armor, ring, conferring +8 Str, +8 Vit, +25 Armor.

Forged for the elite honor guard who once stood motionless beside the ancient basalt platforms of the caldera. Every plate sits with balanced authority, turning a veteran captain into an immovable pillar on the battlefield.

title: of the Void-Eye
summary: Masterwork tier-5 suffix for staves, hats, and amulets granting top intellect and swift mana regeneration.

p: "of the Void-Eye" (Suffix, tier 5) — Etched with fine silver survey-sigils that draw stray ley-current straight out of the air. Bound to staff, hat, amulet, conferring +9 Int, +2.4 Mana regen.

Cut with dark, reflective facets that seem to stare straight through smoke, fog, and illusion. Senior archons prize void-eye craft for keeping their mana wells brimming even during the fiercest endgame sieges.

title: of the Unbroken
summary: Bastion tier-5 suffix for shields and armor combining high block chance with massive maximum health.

p: "of the Unbroken" (Suffix, tier 5) — Peened and double-riveted on Ironcamp anvils to turn aside lance tips, shrapnel, and crushing warhammers. Bound to shield, armor, conferring +15 Block %, +110 Max hp.

Dedicated to the rearguard companies who held burning piers and collapsed walls without taking a single step back. Gear of the unbroken absorbs punishing blows from titans and dread knights without yielding an inch.

title: of Reckoning
summary: Decisive tier-5 weapon suffix delivering heavy raw damage alongside high armor penetration.

p: "of Reckoning" (Suffix, tier 5) — Peened and double-riveted on Ironcamp anvils to turn aside lance tips, shrapnel, and crushing warhammers. Bound to weapon, conferring +26 Damage, +14 Armor pen.

Nothing subtle about this forge-mark—it is hammered onto endgame steel meant to settle four acts of blood and betrayal. Plate, stone hide, and ancient wards alike split open when reckoning finally arrives.

title: Jagged
summary: Low-tier weapon prefix (tiers 1–2) that adds a small, reliable flat damage increase.

p: "Jagged" (Prefix, tier 1-2) — Ground on wet quarry whetstones until the bevel bites straight through iron rings and boiled leather. Bound to weapon, conferring +1-1 Damage.

Roughly filed by border levies who lacked proper whetstones and settled for raw, tearing teeth along the blade. It looks disgraceful at inspection, yet a jagged edge chews through gnoll hide far better than dull iron.

title: Serrated
summary: Mid-early weapon prefix (tiers 2–3) boosting both flat damage and strike accuracy.

p: "Serrated" (Prefix, tier 2-3) — Balanced and shaved to feather-light tolerances so scouts and archers loose without hesitation. Bound to weapon, conferring +2-3 Damage, +1 Acc.

Cut with deliberate saw-notches by Greywood millwrights turned armorer during the northern shortages. The toothed edge catches cleanly on leather straps and bone, steadying blows that might otherwise skid wide.

title: Keen
summary: Upper-tier weapon prefix (tiers 3–4) granting solid bonus damage and sharpened accuracy.

p: "Keen" (Prefix, tier 3-4) — Balanced and shaved to feather-light tolerances so scouts and archers loose without hesitation. Bound to weapon, conferring +3-5 Damage, +2 Acc.
Honed patiently on oiled river-slate until the bevel can shave a dry willow twig without catching. Experienced duelists and harbor marines pay extra for keen steel that rewards clean footwork.

title: Cruel
summary: High-tier weapon prefix (tiers 4–5) delivering heavy bonus damage and strong accuracy.

p: "Cruel" (Prefix, tier 4-5) — Balanced and shaved to feather-light tolerances so scouts and archers loose without hesitation. Bound to weapon, conferring +5-8 Damage, +3 Acc.

Forged with wicked weight distribution and needle-fine geometry by ironcamp smiths who stopped caring about chivalry years ago. Cruel weapons bite deep through mail and marrow, ending skirmishes before the enemy can rally.

title: Stout
summary: Early defensive prefix (tiers 1–2) for armor, shields, helms, and boots adding defense and absorption.

p: "Stout" (Prefix, tier 1-2) — Peened and double-riveted on Ironcamp anvils to turn aside lance tips, shrapnel, and crushing warhammers. Bound to armor, shield, helm, boots, conferring +1 Def, +1 Abs.
Thick-cut hide and doubled iron straps assembled in Thornwick's crowded repair sheds. Stout gear adds a little groan to your knees on steep hills, yet it keeps stray arrows from ruining your week.

title: Hardened
summary: Mid-early defensive prefix (tiers 2–3) for protective gear boosting defense and damage absorption.

p: "Hardened" (Prefix, tier 2-3) — Peened and double-riveted on Ironcamp anvils to turn aside lance tips, shrapnel, and crushing warhammers. Bound to armor, shield, helm, boots, conferring +2 Def, +1 Abs.
Case-hardened in bone-charcoal and salt brine until the outer skin rings sharp under a knuckle-tap. Caravan guards trust hardened kit to weather canyon ambushes without splitting at the rivets.

title: Tempered
summary: Advanced defensive prefix (tiers 3–4) for armor, shields, helms, and boots adding strong defense and absorption.

p: "Tempered" (Prefix, tier 3-4) — Peened and double-riveted on Ironcamp anvils to turn aside lance tips, shrapnel, and crushing warhammers. Bound to armor, shield, helm, boots, conferring +2 Def, +2 Abs.

Drawn back carefully over glowing coals until the steel turns straw-blue, balancing toughness against brittle cracking. Oakhaven armorers stamp tempered harness for veterans who expect to trade blows with stone golems.

title: Indomitable
summary: Endgame defensive prefix (tiers 4–5) for protective gear delivering high defense and heavy absorption.

p: "Indomitable" (Prefix, tier 4-5) — Peened and double-riveted on Ironcamp anvils to turn aside lance tips, shrapnel, and crushing warhammers. Bound to armor, shield, helm, boots, conferring +3 Def, +3 Abs.

Layered with dark caldera ironstone and riveted tight enough to outlast the soldier inside it. Indomitable harness turns glancing hits into sparks and absorbs direct impacts that would pulp ordinary plate.

title: Glowing
summary: Early universal prefix (tiers 1–2) usable on any gear slot to add a light damage bonus.

p: "Glowing" (Prefix, tier 1-2) — Tempered over caldera slag-coals and rubbed with brimstone oil so heat clings along every seam. Bound to all battle gear, conferring +1-1 Damage.

Warm as a pocketed hearth-stone, glowing craft carries the faint orange shimmer of beginner pyromancy. Scouts dislike how it gives away a camp in the dark, though nobody refuses the extra punch in a brawl.

title: Fiery
summary: Mid-tier universal prefix (tiers 2–4) usable on any gear slot to grant a steady damage increase.

p: "Fiery" (Prefix, tier 2-4) — Tempered over caldera slag-coals and rubbed with brimstone oil so heat clings along every seam. Bound to all battle gear, conferring +2-3 Damage.
Touched by kiln-fire runes that leave tiny soot-marks on cloth and make iron hilts pleasantly warm in freezing rain. Fiery gear lends crisp thermal bite to strikes across the marshes and wastes.

title: Volcanic
summary: High-tier universal prefix (tiers 4–5) usable on any gear slot for substantial bonus damage.

p: "Volcanic" (Prefix, tier 4-5) — Tempered over caldera slag-coals and rubbed with brimstone oil so heat clings along every seam. Bound to all battle gear, conferring +4-6 Damage.
Steeped in the roaring drafts of the Obsidian Caldera until veins of molten orange pulse beneath the finish. Every piece radiates dry, impatient heat that scorches enemy hides on contact.

title: Chilly
summary: Early universal prefix (tiers 1–2) usable on any gear slot to add a light defense bonus.

p: "Chilly" (Prefix, tier 1-2) — Quenched in winter river-rime and coastal brine to bleed warmth from incoming blows and chill exposed steel. Bound to all battle gear, conferring +1 Def.
Cool to the touch even at high noon, carrying a thin trace of northern river-frost. Soldiers marching out of Thornwick enjoy how chilly trim stiffens soft leather against clumsy slashes.

title: Glacial
summary: High-tier universal prefix (tiers 3–5) usable on any gear slot providing strong defense and absorption.

p: "Glacial" (Prefix, tier 3-5) — Quenched in winter river-rime and coastal brine to bleed warmth from incoming blows and chill exposed steel. Bound to all battle gear, conferring +2 Def, +1 Abs.
Encrusted with pale, permanent rime harvested from ancient alpine cisterns. Glacial gear hardens air and metal alike into a rigid barrier that blunts heavy swings and laughs at volcanic heat.

title: Breezy
summary: Early universal prefix (tiers 1–2) usable on any gear slot to grant a small accuracy boost.

p: "Breezy" (Prefix, tier 1-2) — Wound with hair-fine copper grounding filaments copied from Thermodynamic Conclave coils. Bound to all battle gear, conferring +1 Acc.
Trimmed with light wind-charms popular among ferrymen and road scouts. A breezy balance takes the sluggish drag out of cheap frontier kit, helping tired hands land cleaner strikes.

title: Storming
summary: High-tier universal prefix (tiers 3–5) usable on any gear slot adding bonus damage and accuracy.

p: "Storming" (Prefix, tier 3-5) — Wound with hair-fine copper grounding filaments copied from Thermodynamic Conclave coils. Bound to all battle gear, conferring +2-3 Damage, +2 Acc.
Humming with bottled coastal squalls that make nearby hair stand on end. Storming gear guides blows with crisp, snapping urgency, striking true even through blinding dust or driving rain.

title: Earthen
summary: Early universal prefix (tiers 1–2) usable on any gear slot to add a light damage absorption bonus.

p: "Earthen" (Prefix, tier 1-2) — Cured in acidic fen-tannin and mineral pitch to turn away rot while coating edges in lingering venom. Bound to all battle gear, conferring +1 Abs.
Rubbed with dense iron-clay and grounded with river-pebble charms by practical border artisans. Earthen gear feels stubbornly solid, taking the sting out of clubs and falling scree.

title: Granite
summary: High-tier universal prefix (tiers 3–5) usable on any gear slot delivering solid defense and absorption.

p: "Granite" (Prefix, tier 3-5) — Cured in acidic fen-tannin and mineral pitch to turn away rot while coating edges in lingering venom. Bound to all battle gear, conferring +2 Def, +2 Abs.
Bound with dense quarry-stone wards that lend ordinary cloth and steel the unyielding mass of a mountain bluff. Frontliners clad in granite-marked gear hold narrow passes like living masonry.

title: Glimmering
summary: Early arcane prefix (tiers 1–2) for weapons, helms, rings, and amulets adding mana and spell power.

p: "Glimmering" (Prefix, tier 1-2) — Etched with fine silver survey-sigils that draw stray ley-current straight out of the air. Bound to weapon, helm, ring, amulet, conferring +6 Mana, +4% Power.
Dusted with crushed river-mica that catches lantern-light with a pale silver sheen. Hedge-mages favor glimmering trinkets for stretching a small mana pool through early frontier skirmishes.

title: Luminescent
summary: Advanced arcane prefix (tiers 3–4) for caster slots granting substantial mana and spell power.

p: "Luminescent" (Prefix, tier 3-4) — Etched with fine silver survey-sigils that draw stray ley-current straight out of the air. Bound to weapon, helm, ring, amulet, conferring +14 Mana, +8% Power.
Etched with fine Collegium prism-lines that pulse softly whenever ley-currents shift nearby. Luminescent gear turns modest incantations into crisp, blinding volleys that scatter packed raiders.

title: Celestial
summary: Endgame arcane prefix (tiers 4–5) for caster slots delivering huge mana reserves and high spell power.

p: "Celestial" (Prefix, tier 4-5) — Etched with fine silver survey-sigils that draw stray ley-current straight out of the air. Bound to weapon, helm, ring, amulet, conferring +24 Mana, +14% Power.
Aligned to pre-schism star charts preserved in the Spire Conclave's highest galleries. Holding celestial-crafted gear feels like tapping a bottomless cold well of pure arcane authority.

title: of Striking
summary: Early offensive suffix (tiers 1–2) for weapons, rings, and amulets adding a modest damage bonus.

p: "of Striking" (Suffix, tier 1-2) — Ground on wet quarry whetstones until the bevel bites straight through iron rings and boiled leather. Bound to weapon, ring, amulet, conferring +1-2 Damage.
Balanced forward toward the tip or knuckle so every swing carries a little extra snap. Thornwick drill-sergeants hand out trinkets of striking to recruits who hit too timidly in line drills.

title: of Carnage
summary: Mid-tier offensive suffix (tiers 2–3) for weapons, rings, and amulets granting solid bonus damage.

p: "of Carnage" (Suffix, tier 2-3) — Ground on wet quarry whetstones until the bevel bites straight through iron rings and boiled leather. Bound to weapon, ring, amulet, conferring +2-4 Damage.
Forged during the brutal Redmarsh caravan wars when polite skirmishes gave way to desperate survival. Gear of carnage is notched, heavy, and unapologetically built to break enemy lines fast.

title: of Slaughter
summary: Endgame offensive suffix (tiers 4–5) for weapons, rings, and amulets delivering heavy bonus damage.

p: "of Slaughter" (Suffix, tier 4-5) — Ground on wet quarry whetstones until the bevel bites straight through iron rings and boiled leather. Bound to weapon, ring, amulet, conferring +4-7 Damage.
Notched with tally-marks by veteran breachers who marched from the burning harbor straight into the caldera. Every strike lands with pitiless weight, turning armored packs into scattered scrap.

title: of the Ox
summary: Early vitality suffix (tiers 1–2) usable on any gear slot to add a small pool of maximum health.

p: "of the Ox" (Suffix, tier 1-2) — Stamped with First Watch endurance wards prized by vanguard pikemen holding narrow river crossings. Bound to all battle gear, conferring +10 HP.
Named for the patient, thick-necked haulers that pull timber carts out of Greywood mud. Wearing gear of the ox lends a little of that stubborn endurance to green soldiers on their first campaign.

title: of the Bear
summary: Mid-tier vitality suffix (tiers 2–4) usable on any gear slot to grant a solid maximum health boost.

p: "of the Bear" (Suffix, tier 2-4) — Stamped with First Watch endurance wards prized by vanguard pikemen holding narrow river crossings. Bound to all battle gear, conferring +20 HP.
Northern trappers stitch bone-beads and thick hide bindings onto gear to mimic the rugged bulk of highland bears. It keeps a soldier standing through ugly blows that would fold a slighter man.

title: of the Behemoth
summary: Endgame vitality suffix (tiers 4–5) usable on any gear slot delivering a large maximum health increase.

p: "of the Behemoth" (Suffix, tier 4-5) — Stamped with First Watch endurance wards prized by vanguard pikemen holding narrow river crossings. Bound to all battle gear, conferring +35 HP.
Inspired by the bleached leviathan ribs towering over Redmarsh Outpost. Veterans clad in gear of the behemoth absorb punishing siege hits with grim calm, refusing to yield ground to titans.

title: of Dexterity
summary: Early precision suffix (tiers 1–2) usable on any gear slot to provide a light accuracy bonus.

p: "of Dexterity" (Suffix, tier 1-2) — Balanced and shaved to feather-light tolerances so scouts and archers loose without hesitation. Bound to all battle gear, conferring +1 Acc.
Laced snug and stripped of clumsy excess leather by scouts who needed steady hands in the rain. Even a minor boost to footwork and aim turns wild frontier swings into clean hits.

title: of Grace
summary: Mid-tier agility suffix (tiers 2–4) usable on any gear slot granting both accuracy and defense.

p: "of Grace" (Suffix, tier 2-4) — Peened and double-riveted on Ironcamp anvils to turn aside lance tips, shrapnel, and crushing warhammers. Bound to all battle gear, conferring +2 Acc, +1 Def.

Tailored for nimble skirmishers and boarding marines who survive by slipping past heavy blades rather than catching them on their ribs. Every buckle sits balanced so the wearer turns on a copper piece.

title: of Nirvana
summary: Endgame mastery suffix (tiers 4–5) usable on any gear slot providing high accuracy and solid defense.

p: "of Nirvana" (Suffix, tier 4-5) — Peened and double-riveted on Ironcamp anvils to turn aside lance tips, shrapnel, and crushing warhammers. Bound to all battle gear, conferring +3 Acc, +2 Def.

Worn by coastal abbey duelists who trained until battlefield chaos felt as quiet as an empty scriptorium. Movements flow without hesitation, guiding strikes cleanly through gaps while dodging counterblows.

title: of Thought
summary: Early mental suffix (tiers 1–2) usable on any gear slot to add a light bonus to maximum mana.

p: "of Thought" (Suffix, tier 1-2) — Etched with fine silver survey-sigils that draw stray ley-current straight out of the air. Bound to all battle gear, conferring +8 Mana.
Inscribed with simple memory-knots used by parish clerks to keep their figures straight on noisy market days. Apprentice casters prize it for squeezing one more spell out of a wet skirmish.

title: of Wisdom
summary: Mid-tier mental suffix (tiers 2–4) usable on any gear slot granting a solid maximum mana reserve.

p: "of Wisdom" (Suffix, tier 2-4) — Etched with fine silver survey-sigils that draw stray ley-current straight out of the air. Bound to all battle gear, conferring +16 Mana.
Favored by veteran hedge-scholars and quartermaster-arcanists who learned that running dry mid-battle is worse than dropping your sword. It steadies the mind and deepens the caster's reserve.

title: of the Archmage
summary: Endgame arcane suffix (tiers 4–5) usable on any gear slot delivering high mana and bonus spell power.

p: "of the Archmage" (Suffix, tier 4-5) — Etched with fine silver survey-sigils that draw stray ley-current straight out of the air. Bound to all battle gear, conferring +28 Mana, +6% Power.

Bearing the high geometric seal of the Spire Conclave's inner circle, gear of the archmage hums with disciplined power. Few pieces survive outside locked vaults, and every caster on the Border covets them.

title: of Health
summary: Early restorative suffix (tiers 1–2) usable on any gear slot adding maximum health and light regeneration.

p: "of Health" (Suffix, tier 1-2) — Stamped with First Watch endurance wards prized by vanguard pikemen holding narrow river crossings. Bound to all battle gear, conferring +15 HP, +1 Regen.
Rubbed with dried willow-bark and fen-herbs by camp healers who never had enough clean linen. It keeps minor cuts knitting together on the march so squads stay fit between towns.

title: of Regeneration
summary: Mid-tier restorative suffix (tiers 2–4) usable on any gear slot boosting maximum health and steady healing.

p: "of Regeneration" (Suffix, tier 2-4) — Stamped with First Watch endurance wards prized by vanguard pikemen holding narrow river crossings. Bound to all battle gear, conferring +25 HP, +2 Regen.
Infused with bitter apothecary salts that keep blood moving cleanly even through alkali fever and damp chill. Frontliners swear gear of regeneration saves half their belt potions over a long siege.

title: of Immortality
summary: Endgame restorative suffix (tiers 4–5) usable on any gear slot delivering high health and rapid regeneration.

p: "of Immortality" (Suffix, tier 4-5) — Stamped with First Watch endurance wards prized by vanguard pikemen holding narrow river crossings. Bound to all battle gear, conferring +40 HP, +3 Regen.
Bound with stubborn First-Dynasty vitality seals that refuse to let a battered soldier stay down. Even amid volcanic ash and dread-knight charges, wounds close fast enough to unnerve anyone watching.

title: of Protection
summary: Early defensive suffix (tiers 1–2) usable on any gear slot granting an elemental or attribute ward.

p: "of Protection" (Suffix, tier 1-2) — Peened and double-riveted on Ironcamp anvils to turn aside lance tips, shrapnel, and crushing warhammers. Bound to all battle gear, conferring Elemental / Attribute bonus.

Scratched with basic roadside shrine-marks by cautious travelers before crossing the Alder bridges. It offers modest shelter against frontier hazards, which is still far better than marching out bare.

title: of Warding
summary: Mid-tier defensive suffix (tiers 2–4) usable on any gear slot providing a stronger elemental or attribute ward.

p: "of Warding" (Suffix, tier 2-4) — Peened and double-riveted on Ironcamp anvils to turn aside lance tips, shrapnel, and crushing warhammers. Bound to all battle gear, conferring Elemental / Attribute bonus.
Blessed by abbey scribes and Collegium assayers to blunt the harsh elements of Redmarsh and the Iron Coast. Veterans rely on warding seals whenever lightning scarabs or frost-bells appear.

title: of the Aegis
summary: Endgame defensive suffix (tiers 4–5) usable on any gear slot granting a high-tier elemental or attribute ward.

p: "of the Aegis" (Suffix, tier 4-5) — Peened and double-riveted on Ironcamp anvils to turn aside lance tips, shrapnel, and crushing warhammers. Bound to all battle gear, conferring Elemental / Attribute bonus.
Modelled on the ancient bastion seals that kept coastal citadels standing through storm and siege. Gear of the aegis wraps its bearer in quiet, reliable resilience fit for the Threshold itself.
